chunks: My father, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Ishaq the Trader, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from al-Hasan ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn al-Fadl, from al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Let none estimate for the Day of Resurrection by saying: O Lord, I did not know that the sons of Fatima are the Guardians, and that it was for the sake of Fatima’s sons, exclusively, that Allah sent down this verse:
«O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair from the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the All-Merciful.»
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the verse 'O My servants who have transgressed against themselves' regarding the children of Fatima?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Wilayah of Fatima's offspring is so well-established that ignorance will not serve as a valid excuse on the Day of Resurrection. He specifically links Surah Az-Zumar 39:53 to them, indicating that the divine promise of forgiveness for those who transgress applies uniquely and profoundly to their lineage, underscoring their elevated spiritual status in Shia tradition.
